rationale: Migrations 0008–0018 add dictionary generation, document, import, and card-authoring structures through nullable columns, additive tables, indexes, and compatible constraint replacements. Migrations 0019–0024 add user-deletion and pronunciation-audio structures and indexes. Migrations 0025–0028 add immutable AI-provider configuration, worker observations, and routing capability checks. Migration 0029 adds the AI-credit ledger tables, additive job accounting columns, audit enum values, and compatible nonnegative audit versions. Migration 0030 adds a fail-closed trigger that affects only newly credit-accounted jobs, which cannot exist until the inactive-by-default feature is activated. Migration 0031 relaxes the new credit-state constraint before activation so retry and settlement transitions remain valid. Migration 0032 adds database guards for immutable grants, append-only history, reservation identity, allocation ownership, and aggregate grant balance; its purge escape is transaction-local and used only by the current account-purge path. Existing rows default to unaccounted, old application slots ignore additive structures, and no existing product data is rewritten or removed. These migrations are expand-compatible; enable managed routing and credit enforcement only after the current API and settlement-capable workers are deployed.
